name: PiAPI
summary: Unified gateway to image, video and audio generation models (Flux, Kling, Midjourney, Luma and more) through two task endpoints.

api_key.description: a PiAPI key (app.piapi.ai workspace > API key)

notes: Every model uses the same two calls: create a task (model, task_type, input) and get the task by its id.
Pay-as-you-go consumes PiAPI credits; host-your-account needs your own vendor account plus a PiAPI seat. config.service_mode picks per task.
Task input and output files are deleted after a period; webhooks (config.webhook_config) deliver results on completion.
Only a few models are named here; the unified create call (piapi.task.create) reaches the rest, per their docs pages.

endpoints.name: Create a task on any PiAPI model
endpoints.summary: The unified create call: pick the model, the task type and the model-specific input.

model.description: Model name, e.g. Qubico/flux1-schnell or kling.

task_type.description: Task type for the model, e.g. txt2img, video_generation.

input.description: Model-specific input; see that model's page in the docs.

config.description: Options: {"service_mode": "public" (pay as you go) or "private" (your own hosted account), "webhook_config": {"endpoint", "secret"}}.

notes: Asynchronous: the response carries data.task_id. Poll piapi.task.get with that id until status is completed or failed (a webhook can be set in config instead).
A job that only produces data, so kind read. Billed in PiAPI credits (pay as you go) or against a hosted-account seat.

endpoints.name: Generate an image with Flux
endpoints.summary: Flux text-to-image: txt2img with a Qubico/flux1 model.

task_type.description: txt2img for plain text-to-image (others: img2img, txt2img-lora, img2img-lora, fill-inpaint, fill-outpaint, redux-variation, controlnet-lora).

input.description: {"prompt": required, "negative_prompt", "width", "height" (txt2img only, width*height at most 1048576), "guidance_scale" 1.5-5, "batch_size" 1-4 (schnell only)}.

config.description: Options: {"service_mode": "public" (pay as you go) or "private" (your own hosted account), "webhook_config": {"endpoint", "secret"}}.

notes: Asynchronous: the response carries data.task_id. Poll piapi.task.get with that id until status is completed or failed (a webhook can be set in config instead).

endpoints.name: Generate a video with Kling

task_type.description: video_generation for video; lip_sync and effects are the other types.

config.description: Options: {"service_mode": "public" (pay as you go) or "private" (your own hosted account), "webhook_config": {"endpoint", "secret"}}.

notes: Asynchronous: the response carries data.task_id. Poll piapi.task.get with that id until status is completed or failed (a webhook can be set in config instead).

Duration limits and pricing depend on version: 4.0 takes 3 to 30 seconds and is billed per second of output; 2.6 and earlier take 5 or 10 seconds and are billed per video; pro mode is 1080p for 3.0 and later.

endpoints.name: Get a task
endpoints.summary: Status, output and cost of a task created by any of the PiAPI create calls.

task_id.description: The task_id returned when the task was created.

notes: Polls the task started by piapi.task.create, piapi.image.flux or piapi.video.kling. status reaches completed or failed; results are in output.
PiAPI deletes task input and output files after a period, so save results promptly.

endpoints.name: Cancel a task
endpoints.summary: Cancels a queued or running task.
notes: Documented for Kling tasks (versions 3.0, 3.0-turbo and 2.6 and earlier); other models may not support cancelling.
